points: 1 Architecture: 14B decoder-only, near-unchanged from phi-3-medium; tiktoken tokenizer with padded vocab 100,352; full attention over 4K instead of a 2K sliding window; context 4K extended to 16K (p. 7)

2 Training setup: pretraining ~10T tokens, peak LR 0.0003, weight decay 0.1, global batch 5760, linear warm-up/decay (p. 7); midtraining 250B tokens, LR 10x lower, rope base frequency 250K, 30% new long-context data + 70% recall tokens, evaluated on HELMET at 8K/16K (p. 10, Table 6)

3 Synthetic data recipe: 50 broad dataset types, ~400B unweighted tokens; seed curation, rewrite/augment, self-revision, instruction reversal, execution validation, plurality-vote question filtering (p. 5); organic data filtered with small classifiers (p. 6)
4 Final pretraining mixture (Table 5, p. 9): web 15% (1.3T unique, 1.2 epochs), web rewrites 15% (290B, 5.2), synthetic 40% (290B, 13.8), code 20% (820B, 2.4), acquired 10% (580B, 1.7)

5 Data ablations: more synthetic epochs beat fresh web tokens (Figure 2); synthetic-only 13B model vs phi-3-medium HumanEval +12.1 but TQA -14.8, with web rewrites TQA -7.7 (Table 3, p. 8); mixture ablations at 7B/1T tokens where synthetic-heavy S averages +0.8 over the final mix, which was kept for knowledge benchmarks (Table 4, p. 9)

6 Post-training recipe: one SFT round (~8B tokens, LR 1e-6, 40 languages, chatml), then pivotal-token DPO, then judge-guided DPO with ~850k pairs from GPT-4o/GPT-4t/own-model responses judged by GPT-4o; pair counts in Tables 7-8 (p. 12)

7 Pivotal Token Search: estimate p(success | prefix) by sampled rollouts checked by an oracle, recursively subdivide the completion to find single tokens shifting it by >= p_gap, build single-token accepted/rejected DPO pairs; questions filtered to 0.2 <= p(success) <= 0.8 (p. 14)

8 Headline results and weak spots (Table 1, simple-evals at temperature 0.5): GPQA 56.1 vs GPT-4o 50.6, Qwen-2.5-14B 42.9, phi-3 31.2; MATH 80.4 vs GPT-4o 74.6; MMLU 84.8 vs 88.1; weak on SimpleQA 3.0, IFEval 63.0, DROP 75.5 (p. 1, p. 18)

9 Post-training ablation (Table 9, p. 16), SFT / DPO stage 1 / stage 2 only / both: GPQA 47.3/53.6/52.4/56.1, MATH 77.1/80.5/77.6/80.4, ArenaHard 56.7/66.5/69.8/75.4; PTS helps reasoning, judge-guided DPO helps ArenaHard, the two are complementary

10 Contamination evidence and what is withheld: fresh Nov 2024 AMC-10/12 test (four tests, max 150, 100 runs, t=0.5) with phi-4's score only in Figure 1, QwQ 124.5 at 4X more tokens (p. 3); PhiBench is internal and was used for tuning; n-gram decontamination misses rephrasing; generator models, compute, absolute pretraining scores and appendices are not given
